 Join a large-scale, high-profile infrastructure project based in Cooma, supporting critical operations within a complex and dynamic IT environment. 
   
 This organisation brings together enterprise platforms, site-based infrastructure, and global support teams, offering a unique opportunity to work across a broad technology stack. 
   
 For candidates based outside the region, FIFO arrangements and accommodation support can be considered. 
   Your new role     
 As a Level 2 IT Administrator, you will act as a hybrid on-site IT generalist, primarily based in Cooma, with travel required every alternate week. You will deliver a mix of end-user support, infrastructure support, and application administration. 
   
  Key responsibilities include:  
 
 Deliver Level 2 end-user and service desk support across hardware, software, and systems 
 Provide Level 1 support for key business applications such as Aconex, Primavera P6, Revit, Revizto, and SAP ECTR 
 Support infrastructure including networks, endpoints, and site connectivity (Level 2) 
 Troubleshoot and resolve issues across Microsoft 365, Windows, Azure, Citrix, and SAP environments 
 Coordinate with internal IT, DSI support teams, and third-party vendors to resolve incidents 
 Maintain documentation for systems, configurations, and support activities 
 Ensure IT systems meet security and compliance standards 
 Manage IT assets including hardware/software inventory and lifecycle 
 Support application administration including user access, configuration, and maintenance 
 
   
  Workload split:  
 
 End-user support: 50% 
 Infrastructure support: 30% 
 Application support: 10% 
 Asset management and administration: 10% 
 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Proven experience in a Level 2 IT support or systems administration role 
 Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, networking, and systems 
 Experience with Microsoft 365, Windows, Azure, Citrix, and general infrastructure 
 Ability to manage competing priorities in a hands-on, site-based environment 
 Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with multiple support teams 
 
   
  Desirable experience:  
 
 SharePoint 
 Primavera P6 Professional 
 Aconex 
 Autodesk Revit / Revizto 
 SAP ECTR 
 LMS or specialist project management tools 
 
 
 Experience in construction, engineering, or project-based environments will be highly regarded. 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Salary package of $160,000 - $180,000 + super 
 Accommodation support where required 
 FIFO options available for non-local candidates 
 Opportunity to work on a major infrastructure project 
 Exposure to a broad and technically diverse environment 
 A hands-on role with strong ownership and autonomy

About Us

Global Enterprising Pty Ltd T/A Solar 4 Life is a trusted Australian provider of residential and commercial solar energy solutions. We specialise in the design, supply, and installation of high-quality solar panel systems, battery storage solutions, EV chargers, and energy-efficient technologies. Our team is committed to delivering reliable renewable energy solutions while maintaining exceptional customer service, regulatory compliance, and project excellence. As our operations continue to grow, we are seeking an experienced Contract Administrator to support the effective administration and coordination of our installation and project contracts.

Key Responsibilities

•	Prepare, review, and administer contracts for residential and commercial solar installation projects.

•	Provide administrative support during project handover and contract close-out processes.

Qualifications

Skills & Experience

•	Strong understanding of contract administration processes within construction, electrical, renewable energy, or related industries.

•	Ability to build positive working relationships with clients, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

•	Ability to interpret contractual documentation and identify potential risks or discrepancies.

•	Understanding of Australian workplace health and safety requirements and relevant industry regulations.

If you are a motivated Contract Administrator looking to build your career with a respected renewable energy company, we encourage you to apply.

We have an exciting opportunity for an IT Operations Engineer to join our National Operations Centre (NOC) team. We are seeking candidates with a strong background in IT systems and networks, coupled with extensive experience in managing IT service desk operations, and providing high-level support to internal and external staff. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in collaborating with various IT teams, ensuring the delivery of high-quality services to the business, while striving for operational excellence.

Please note this will be a permanent, full-time role based out of our Sydney CBD Office. It will involve participation in a continuous shift roster - working 4 days on and 4 days off. The shift patterns will be made up of 2-day shifts from 7am-7pm and 2-night shifts from 7pm-7am. 

Some of your responsibilities will include and are not limited to
•	Monitoring critical business services and systems, networks and infrastructure
•	Provide after-hours service desk support to users
•	Identify and address issues before they affect business operations
•	Handle and administer privileged accounts securely

What you’ll have done
•	Seasoned service desk analyst, NOC or equivalent experience (minimum 2 years), ideally in a continuous shift operations centre (24/7x365)
•	Strong technical knowledge of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, SNMP, DNS, DHCP, and other networking protocols
•	Strong problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues quickly, including experience with major incidents
•	Familiarity with server operating systems (e.g., Windows, Linux) and basic server administration
•	Experience with technology service monitoring tools - systems, application, and networks such as Centreon, Solarwinds, PTRG desirable
•	Familiarity with IT service management tools and frameworks (ITIL v3/4)
•	Demonstrated experience in delivering exemplary support, customer service and training
•	Excellent documentation skills for keeping records of issues, resolutions, and operational procedures
•	Effective communication with the ability to work as part of a team, especially in a high-pressure environment where collaboration is essential to solving issues

What we can offer you
•	5 weeks annual leave 
•	Annual salary between 90,000 - 95,000
•	Opportunities to progress within I-MED’s continued growth and expansion 
•	Being part of a team that makes a difference to the functioning of our ever-growing business 
•	Experience in communicating with different areas of IT 
•	Enjoy exclusive benefits including discounted private health insurance, salary packaging, Fitness Passport access, lifestyle and travel discounts, I-MED services for your family and employee wellbeing support.

About Us
At I-MED, we're more than just a medical imaging provider - we're a community of passionate professionals committed to excellence for our patients. With over 200 clinics and a staggering 6 million patient procedures annually, we proudly stand as one of the largest providers of medical imaging in the world. Our success lies in our people with over 350 dedicated doctors and 4,000 staff members who actively share clinical knowledge and expertise. 

If you're looking for the next step in your career and are passionate about the delivery of excellence within healthcare services, apply today!

## Telecommunications Technical Officer / Technologist
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Telecommunications Technical Officer or Technologist to join our team and contribute to the delivery of reliable, high-performance telecommunications infrastructure. This role is responsible for the design, installation, maintenance, and optimisation of complex communication networks and systems across a range of technologies. The ideal candidate brings solid hands-on technical experience, strong analytical capability, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. This position suits a proactive professional who is committed to maintaining the highest standards of network performance and service delivery.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain microwave, satellite, telemetry, and other radio and electromagnetic communication systems, ensuring all equipment operates to specification and within regulatory requirements.
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve network faults, performance issues, and equipment malfunctions in a timely and effective manner, minimising disruption to services.
- Integrate telecommunications networks with computer hardware, software platforms, operating systems, databases, and peripheral devices to ensure seamless end-to-end functionality.
- Monitor the ongoing performance of complex networks and communication systems, identifying trends, anomalies, and areas for optimisation before they impact service quality.
- Plan and support the development of customer access network infrastructure, contributing to capacity planning, design reviews, and upgrade programmes.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation including inventory logs, equipment records, asset statuses, and communication policies, procedures, and quality standards in accordance with organisational and regulatory guidelines.
- Provide clear technical advice and support to internal stakeholders, project teams, and end users on telecommunications systems, configurations, and best practices.
- Liaise with vendors, suppliers, and external service providers to coordinate procurement, installation activities, and ongoing service delivery, whilst monitoring contractual performance and obligations.
- Support the design and optimisation of network architecture, contributing technical input to projects aimed at improving reliability, scalability, and performance.
- Conduct routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and equipment testing to ensure network integrity and compliance with applicable standards.
- Assist in the development and review of technical documentation, including network diagrams, standard operating procedures, and incident reports.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams on telecommunications projects, providing technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle from scoping through to commissioning and handover.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A diploma, advanced diploma, or bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent industry experience in lieu of formal qualifications.
- Demonstrated experience in a telecommunications technical role, with hands-on exposure to radio frequency (RF), microwave, satellite, or fixed-line communication systems.
- Solid understanding of network protocols, telecommunications standards, and systems integration principles.
- Proficiency in configuring and troubleshooting network hardware, software, and associated technologies including switches, routers, and transmission equipment.
- Experience with network monitoring tools and fault management systems, with the ability to interpret performance data and take corrective action.
- Strong documentation skills with the ability to maintain accurate records, produce technical reports, and adhere to quality and compliance standards.
- Effective communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work methodically under pressure, and deliver outcomes within agreed timeframes.
- A valid Australian driver's licence, as field-based work and site visits may be required.
- Willingness to participate in an on-call roster or undertake out-of-hours work when operational requirements demand.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent telecommunications qualifications.
- Experience working with microwave backhaul systems, fibre optic networks, or mobile network infrastructure (2G/3G/4G/5G).
- Familiarity with Australian telecommunications regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements, including those governed by the ACMA.
- Exposure to project management methodologies and experience contributing to telecommunications infrastructure projects.
- Knowledge of ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed services or enterprise network environment.
- Postgraduate qualifications in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related discipline.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and highly skilled engineering team working on critical telecommunications infrastructure that makes a real difference to communities and businesses across Australia.
- Enjoy genuine opportunities for professional development, including access to industry training, certifications, and career progression pathways within the organisation.
- Benefit from a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance, with options for hybrid arrangements where operational requirements allow.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with superannuation contributions, and access to additional employee benefits including wellness programmes and paid leave entitlements.
- Work on a diverse range of projects and technologies that will broaden your technical expertise and keep you at the forefront of the evolving telecommunications landscape.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation
